title: Page 3
content_zh:
“不要随便浪费医疗资源，只不过是不小心撞到头就来挂急诊，那其他严重伤患怎么办？”

有道理……

“好，我知道了，谢谢——”舞冬末才想收回健保卡，转眼间却被另一只手给凌空拦截走了。

啪一声，健保卡再次被丢在急诊柜台上！

“护士小姐，我朋友是被一个流氓甩到地上然后头狠狠地撞上石柱，头晕想吐额头还肿了起来，如果你让她就这样回家，出了事你负责吗？”齐藤浅羽瞄了一眼护士的名牌。“蒋心如小姐？要不要我转告贵医院的院长，你就是这样对待一个可能脑震荡的病人的？”

护士小姐看着眼前这个高大英俊却显得冷酷无情的男生，明明对方看起来很年轻，可无形中却散发出一种不容置喙的大人气势，一时之间竟说不出反驳的话来，脸上不禁三条线。“看她那个样子应该还好……”

“致命的通常都是看不见的地方。请问你是医生吗？可以一眼就判定病人的病严不严重？”齐藤浅羽把健保卡再一次往前推，一脸的酷寒。“快点，不要耽误大家的时间，你不会以为我们闲闲没事喜欢跑来逛医院吧？”

该说他是正义凛然？还是不知死活？不过不管是哪一个，反正他的帅酷冷都已经达到威胁的效果，柜台那儿乖乖地替她挂了号。

舞冬末从头到尾没插嘴，乖乖地任他摆布，然后很快被安排照了头部X光，肿起的伤口在医生看过之后也很快有人接手处理。

“三天内如果有恶心想吐的症状，要记得再来医院。”这是医嘱。

“是，谢谢医生。”舞冬末很礼貌地欠身离开。

拿好药走出医院，舞冬末也很礼貌地对这位救命恩人躬身行了一个礼。“谢谢你，学长，很感谢你今天多管闲事救了我一命，更感谢你亲自开车送我来医院看医生，我舞冬末是个有恩报恩的人，今后学长如果有需要冬末为你效劳的地方，请不要客气，冬末一定尽心尽力报答你……”

她边说边偷偷抬眸睇他。

齐藤浅羽好笑地盯着她，她那比演戏台词还长的话，也很有耐心把它给听完。“说完了？”

“嗯。”舞冬末点点头，又看他一眼，他嫌这样的感恩词太少了吗？“呃……如果你觉得还不够，我可以继续。”

齐藤浅羽挑了挑眉，想笑却忍住了。“上车，我送你回去。”

“不用了，我可以自己回——”

“上车，别让我说第二次。”齐藤浅羽替她开了车门，黑眸淡淡地扫向她，大有她不上车绝不轻易罢休的意味。

舞冬末看着他，没再说什么地上了车，反正她之前在新生舞会上发生的所有糗事都被他看见了，还被人家抱了、看了……她低头瞧了一眼身上的衬衫，突然想起自己连对方的名字都没问。

“学长，请问你的大名？年级系别？身上的衣服，我洗好会送去还给你。”

“衣服不是我的。”

嗄？“那是……”不准备告诉她名字的意思吗？他怕她之后去缠着他？还是他天性为善不欲人知？

就在舞冬末羞窘得手脚都不知该怎么摆才好时，耳边才听见他那好听而带笑的嗓音——

“衣服是费安的，大三企管系。”齐藤浅羽微笑地看着她，朝她伸出手。“我叫齐藤浅羽，日本华裔，京都产业大学交换学生，很高兴认识你，舞冬末小学妹。”

咦？她意外地眨眨眼。“你知道我的名字？”

“我看过你的健保卡，上面有名字。”

“噢，对。”舞冬末脸红红地伸出手，轻轻握住他那只看起来修长又好看的手。“很谢谢你帮了我。”

“举手之劳而已，你不必想以身相许。”他握住她的手，温热的掌心包围住她小巧又柔嫩的手，没有急着放开。

她看着他握着她的那只手，脸更红，心跳得更快了。“我没有要以身相许。”

“是吗？那真是可惜，我本来很期待呢。”

“嗄？”她张大小嘴，瞪大了眼抬头瞧着他，却见他嘴角微弯，笑容晏晏，摆明着是在戏弄她，那模样该是可恶的，可在这密闭的车子里，淡淡的月光洒入，这样的他看起来却是那么的令人心动，害她的心怦怦乱跳着。

这笑，齐藤浅羽足足撑了两分钟才收起。他一向不习惯这样笑，也很少这样笑，因为这样笑着的他看起来太良善无害，嘴角上还有小小的梨窝，可爱迷人到根本会引人犯罪。

瞧此刻她红红的小脸和闪亮亮的眼睛就知道了，那是一种少女的娇羞与心动。

就算舞冬末跟一般十八岁少女不大一样，多了一点好多管闲事的正义感，敢说敢做且勇于认错，面对凶神恶煞也抬头挺胸，完全不表现出害怕的样子，可她终究还是个十八岁的少女。

一个轻易便能被撩拨心思，情绪全都写在那白皙清秀脸上的青涩年纪。

一个容易喜欢上别人，很容易心动的年纪。

也是个很容易被欺骗的年纪……

“家住哪儿？”齐藤浅羽敛起了笑，问她。

“你就一直直走再右转再右转……”她说着，开始比手画脚。

“你可以直接告诉我地址。”

“你从日本来，对台北又不熟——”

他睨了她一眼，好笑道：“GPS的功能应该比你这样比手画脚来得强。”

舞冬末笑了，有点尴尬道：“噢，也是，都忘了刚刚来医院时你也用过那玩意。”

说着，她报了自家地址，就在十五分钟可到的距离。

齐藤浅羽的开车技术挺不错，流畅稳当，坐起来平稳而舒适，车里播放着CD，听得见潺潺流水声和鸟叫虫鸣，这些，都是刚刚头昏昏的她没有注意到的。

“你喜欢住在乡下？”

“你是因为音乐才这么问的吧？”

“嗯。”

浅羽淡淡一笑。“那只是我排遣思乡寂寞的一种方式罢了。”

她转头看着他，他英俊迷人的侧脸彷佛也因为这句话而染上一点孤单，让她莫名地心疼起来。

“你很想家吧？”

“那里毕竟有我的亲人和朋友。”

“我可以当你的朋友！”

齐藤浅羽的目光若有所思，轻轻扫了过来——

这一眼，让她意识到自己刚刚说了什么，瞬间脸又红了。幸好车子里够暗，他应该不会发现她现在的脸很红、心跳很快吧？

“嗯……我的意思是，只要你在台湾的一天，我都可以当你的朋友……”头低了下去，不敢让他看见她的脸。“其实我没别的意思……唉，我想像你这种人走到哪都应该不缺朋友才对，你就当没听见我刚刚说的话吧……”

“如果我不在台湾，你就不当我朋友了？”他带笑的低沉语调，打断了她那又是羞又是懊恼的喃喃自语。

嗄？舞冬末抬起头来看向他，水润的眸光中闪动着一股跳跃。

他这话的意思是——他愿意让她当他的朋友？

“学长……”不知道为什么，她觉得好幸运又好感动。

“留个电话吧，朋友。”他微笑着对她说。

眼角，捕捉到她眉眼之间的欢喜与害羞。

她是个直率可爱又迷人的少女，喜怒哀乐全都不加隐藏……

一如他所想像的……

容易捕获。

第2章(1)

齐藤浅羽一点都不意外再看见舞冬末那张红扑扑的清秀小脸。

坐在教室内往外看，不远不近的距离——

洗好烫好的衬衫，她像呈贡品似地用双手拿给了费安，还对人家鞠了一个躬，感谢人家把衬衫给她穿。
content_en:
"Don't waste medical resources casually. You just come to the emergency room if you hit your head accidentally. What about other seriously injured patients?"

Makes sense...

"Okay, I understand, thank you -" Wu Dongmo wanted to take back the health insurance card, but in the blink of an eye, he was intercepted by another hand in the air.

With a bang, the health insurance card was thrown on the emergency room counter again!

"Ms. Nurse, my friend was thrown to the ground by a gangster and then hit her head hard on a stone pillar. She was dizzy and wanted to vomit and her forehead was swollen. If you let her go home like this, will you be responsible for what happened?" Saito Asaha glanced at the nurse's name tag."Miss Jiang Xinru? Do you want me to tell the director of your hospital that this is how you treat a patient who may have a concussion?"

The nurse lady looked at the tall, handsome but ruthless boy in front of her. Although he looked very young, he exuded an undeniable aura of an adult. For a moment, she couldn't say anything to refute, and there were three lines on her face."She should be fine looking like that..."

"The fatalities are usually in invisible places. Are you a doctor? Can you tell whether the patient's illness is serious or not at a glance?" Saito Asaba pushed the health insurance card forward again, with a cold look on his face."Come on, don't waste everyone's time. You don't think we like to come to the hospital when we have nothing to do, do you?"

Should we say he is righteous and awe-inspiring?Still do not know whether to live or die?But no matter which one it was, his handsomeness had already achieved a threatening effect, and he obediently registered her number at the counter.

Wu Dongmo didn't interrupt from beginning to end, obediently letting him do what he wanted, and was quickly arranged to have his head X-rayed. The swollen wound was quickly taken care of by the doctor after it was seen.

"If you have symptoms of nausea and vomiting within three days, remember to come back to the hospital." This is the doctor's advice.

"Yes, thank you doctor." Wu Dongmo bowed and left politely.

After taking the medicine and walking out of the hospital, Wu Dongmo bowed politely to his lifesaver."Thank you, senior. Thank you very much for saving my life by interfering in your own business today. Thank you even more for driving me to the hospital to see a doctor. I, Wu Dongmo, am a person who repays kindness. In the future, senior, if you need Dongmo's service for you, please don't be polite. Dongmo will do his best to repay you..."

As she spoke, she secretly raised her eyes to look at him.

Saito Asaba stared at her funny, and she patiently listened to her words that were longer than her acting lines."Finished?"

"Yes." Wu Dongmo nodded and looked at him again. Did he think such words of gratitude were too few?"Uh...if you think it's not enough, I can continue."

Saito Asayu raised his eyebrows and wanted to laugh but held back."Get in the car, I'll take you back."

"No, I can go back by myself-"

"Get in the car, don't make me say it a second time." Saito Asayu opened the car door for her, and his dark eyes glanced at her lightly, indicating that she would never give up easily until she got in the car.

Wu Dongmo looked at him and got on the car without saying anything. Anyway, he had seen all the embarrassing things that happened to her at the freshman dance, and she was hugged and looked at by others... She lowered her head and glanced at the shirt on her body, and suddenly remembered that she didn't even ask the other person's name.

"Senior, may I ask your name? What's your grade level? I'll wash the clothes you're wearing and return them to you."

"The clothes are not mine."

Huh?"That's..." Aren't you going to tell her what the name means?Is he afraid that she will pester him later?Or is he just kind by nature and doesn't want others to know about him?

Just when Wu Dong was so embarrassed that she didn't know how to move her hands and feet, her ears heard his nice and funny voice——

"The clothes belong to Fei An, a junior in the corporate management department." Saito Qianyu looked at her with a smile and stretched out his hand towards her."My name is Saito Asaba, a Chinese-Japanese, and an exchange student at Kyoto Sangyo University. Nice to meet you, Maifuyu Sue Elementary School girl."

Huh?She blinked in surprise."You know my name?"

"I saw your health insurance card and it has your name on it."

"Oh, yes." Wu Dongmo blushed and stretched out her hand, gently holding his long and beautiful hand."Thank you very much for helping me."

"It's just a matter of effort, you don't have to think about committing yourself." He held her hand, his warm palm surrounded her small and tender hand, and he didn't let go in a hurry.

She looked at the hand he held hers, her face turned redder, and her heart beat faster."I didn't intend to commit myself to you."

"Really? That's a shame, I was looking forward to it."

"Huh?" She opened her mouth and looked up at him with wide eyes, but she saw that the corners of his mouth were slightly curved and he was smiling. It was obvious that he was teasing her. That look should be hateful, but in this closed car, with the faint moonlight shining in, he looked so exciting like this, which made her heart beat wildly.

Saito Asayu held on to this smile for a full two minutes before putting it away.He has never been used to smiling like this, and rarely smiles like this, because when he smiles like this, he looks too kind and harmless, with small pear holes at the corners of his mouth, so cute and charming that it can lead to sin.

Just look at her red face and shining eyes at this moment, you can tell that it is a kind of girlish shyness and excitement.

Even though Wu Dongmo is different from the average eighteen-year-old girl. She has a little more nosy sense of justice, dares to speak and do things, and has the courage to admit her mistakes. She holds her head high when facing evil spirits and does not show fear at all, but she is still an eighteen-year-old girl after all.

A youthful young man whose thoughts can be stirred easily, and all his emotions are written on his fair and delicate face.

An age when it is easy to fall in love with others and be easily moved.

It’s also an age where it’s easy to be deceived…

"Where do you live?" Saito Qianyu asked her with a smile.

"You just keep going straight and then turn right and then turn right..." she said and started gesticulating with her hands and feet.

"You can just tell me the address."

"You are from Japan and you are not familiar with Taipei -"

He glanced at her and said amusedly: "The function of GPS should be better than your pretentiousness."

Wu Dongmo smiled and said a little embarrassed: "Oh, that's right. I forgot that you used that thing when you just came to the hospital."

With that said, she reported her home address, which was only fifteen minutes away.

Saito Asaba's driving skills are quite good, smooth and steady, and the ride is smooth and comfortable. CDs are playing in the car, and she can hear the sound of gurgling water and the chirping of birds and insects. These are things that she did not notice when she was just dizzy.

"You like living in the country?"

"You're asking that because of the music, right?"

"Yeah."

Qian Yu smiled faintly."That's just a way for me to relieve my homesickness and loneliness."

She turned to look at him, and his handsome and charming profile seemed to be tinged with loneliness because of these words, which made her feel inexplicably distressed.

"You miss home, don't you?"

"After all, I have family and friends there."

"I can be your friend!"

Saito Asayu's eyes were thoughtful, and he glanced over lightly——

This glance made her realize what she had just said, and her face turned red instantly.Fortunately, the car was dark enough, so he probably wouldn't notice that her face was very red and her heart was beating fast, right?

"Well... I mean, as long as you are in Taiwan for a day, I can be your friend..." She lowered her head, not daring to let him see her face."Actually, I don't mean anything else... Well, I imagine that a person like you should have no shortage of friends wherever he goes. Just pretend you didn't hear what I just said..."

"If I wasn't in Taiwan, wouldn't you be my friend?" His low, laughing tone interrupted her murmur of shame and annoyance.

Huh?Wu Dongmo raised her head and looked at him, with a jump in her moist eyes.

What does he mean by this - is he willing to let her be his friend?

"Senior..." She didn't know why, but she felt so lucky and touched.

"Leave a phone number, friend." He said to her with a smile.

From the corner of his eyes, he caught the joy and shyness between her eyebrows.

She is a straightforward, lovely and charming girl who does not hide her joys, sorrows and joys...

Just as he imagined...

Easy to catch.

Chapter 2(1)

Saito Asaha was not surprised to see Wu Dongsue's rosy and delicate face again.

Sitting in the classroom and looking outside, the distance is neither far nor close——

After washing and pressing the shirt, she gave it to Fei An with both hands as if it were a tribute. She also bowed to him and thanked him for giving her the shirt to wear.
